name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 28
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1b. Demands an immediate and full military embargo against Israel, covering, among others, weapons, ammunition, dual-use goods, and surveillance technologies, including the ban of all transfer and transit of arms to Israel and the exclusion of entities owned or controlled by Israeli corporations from European funding;
